Input:MeetingNotes.title: Meeting Notes
Input:MeetingNotes.description: The meeting notes text from which to extract financial plans. Include plan names, types, statuses, priorities, and target dates. Include "Today's Date: {current date}" at the beginning of the meeting notes input.

Input:InputData.title: Input Data
Input:InputData.description: The JSON input that retrieves the picklist values. Default to value {"picklistRequest":[{"objectName":"FinancialPlan","fields":["Status","Type"]}]}.
